research_question: Can source-defined M1 signed flow pressure, informed-late-flow direction, and microstructure reliability gates produce economically viable 30-second XAUUSD entries on canonical Stage-A without parameter rescue?

part4.title: Market Microstructure in MQL5 (Part 4): Volatility That Remembers
part4.jump_intensity: 90 completed M1 close returns; bipower variation = (pi/2)*mean(abs(r_t)*abs(r_t-1)); jump when r^2 > 9*BPV; jump intensity = jump count / valid return count

part5.title: Market Microstructure in MQL5 (Part 5): Microstructure Noise
part5.order_imbalance: volume-weighted centered close location within bar range, clipped [-1,1]

part6.title: Market Microstructure in MQL5 (Part 6): Order Flow
part6.smart_money: late 15-bar log-return sum minus early 15-bar log-return sum, normalized by 90-bar range/midpoint, clipped [-1,1]
part6.flow_confidence: 0 if jump_intensity>0.021; if noise>0.632 then max(0,0.7*(1-(noise-0.632)/(1-0.632))); else clip(1-(noise/0.632)*0.3,0,1)
part6.note: Published thresholds were calibrated on NQ M1; this is a strict source-threshold XAUUSD screen, not an instrument-calibrated optimization.

C01_SOURCE_FLOW_SMI.condition: flow_confidence >= 0.565 AND ((flow_imbalance > 0.092 AND smart_money > 0) OR (flow_imbalance < -0.055 AND smart_money < 0))

C02_FLOW_SMI_MOMENTUM.condition: C01 plus flow_momentum has the same sign as entry direction
C02_FLOW_SMI_MOMENTUM.role: source-derived persistence check using Part-6 flow-momentum semantics

C03_PART5_CLEAN_IMBALANCE.role: exact Part-5 clean-noise imbalance example without Part-6 SMI

timing.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after decision edge
timing.tick_volume: count of source ticks inside each completed M1 bar
timing.rolling_windows: include the just-completed decision bar and only earlier completed bars

selection_rule: Advance only preregistered profiles passing supply/economic gates. Rank strong survivors by direct net, then official wins, then trade count. No threshold or execution rescue after results.
restrictions: no XAUUSD threshold calibration inside this Stage-A screen
